column1: Knowledge

The demo as-of date is 2026-09-30. Any question about today or now refers to that date. The latest complete month is September 2026 and the latest complete ISO week starts 2026-09-21. The rolling 12 months means 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 and the prior 12 months means 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30.

Nordmark Dagligvaror is a Swedish grocery group with three banners. Kronmat is the discount banner with about 120 large supermarkets. Torghallen is the neighbourhood banner with about 90 smaller stores including franchise stores. Grosshallen is the hypermarket banner with 38 out-of-town stores acquired on 2025-01-01. All amounts are SEK excluding VAT.

Like-for-like (LFL) growth compares only comparable stores: stores opened before 2024-10-01 and still trading (STORES.IS_LFL_COMPARABLE). Banner and group like-for-like figures are ratios of summed sales never averages of store percentages. Total sales growth includes new and closed stores and is a different number.

Grosshallen is the underperforming banner. Over the rolling 12 months its like-for-like sales fell about 1.4 percent while Kronmat grew about 2 percent and Torghallen about 4.8 percent and the group about 1.3 percent. Grosshallen transactions fell about 5.6 percent while its average basket rose about 4.4 percent so the decline is driven by fewer customer visits not smaller baskets.

Grosshallen gross margin is about 24.5 percent against about 26.8 percent at Kronmat and about 30.5 percent at Torghallen. Grosshallen lost about SEK 35 million of EBIT per quarter through 2025 and reached break-even in 2026 after structural cost measures (store labour cut from about 13.5 to 11.3 percent of sales); Q3 2026 EBIT was about SEK +9 million.

Grosshallen Sundsvik in Helsingborg stopped trading as a hypermarket on 2026-08-15 and reopened as Kronmat Sundsvik on 2026-09-05. It is the only closure or conversion in the data and it is excluded from like-for-like figures.

The hero store is Grosshallen Västerhamn in Göteborg (store id ST-0001 peer cluster Grosshallen / Suburban family). Over the rolling 12 months it sold about SEK 161 million which is about 62 percent of its catchment potential of about SEK 259 million while the median store in its cluster captures about 92 percent. Its potential gap of about SEK 99 million is the largest in the Grosshallen banner.

At Grosshallen Västerhamn the rolling-12-month sales fell about 7.5 percent: transactions fell about 11 percent (a transactions effect of about SEK -20 million) while the average basket rose about 4 percent (a basket effect of about SEK +7 million). The growth driver is transactions not basket.

Grosshallen Västerhamn has the worst on-shelf availability in the Grosshallen banner: about 89 percent in Dairy and Bread & Bakery over the last 13 weeks against a 96 percent target. Its overall availability is about 91 percent versus about 97 percent for its peer cluster and its markdown rate (about 2.0 percent of sales) is about 50 percent above the cluster.

Across the group 25 comparable stores have Dairy and Bread & Bakery availability below 94 percent in the last 13 weeks. Their average like-for-like growth is about 3.4 points weaker than the stores with availability of 94 percent or better. The availability target is 96 percent and the alert threshold is 94 percent.

The discount competitor Billigmat opened a store 1.1 km from Grosshallen Västerhamn on 2026-03-12 (COMPETITOR_EVENTS event CEV-001). In the six months after the opening Västerhamn sales were about 9.5 percent below the same six months a year earlier.

Loyalty data comes from three programs (Kronmat Plus Torghallen Klubb Grosshallen Kort) with six customer segments: Families Seniors Students Urban singles Value seekers and Premium. Families visits at Grosshallen fell about 17 percent over the rolling 12 months (about 23 percent at Grosshallen Västerhamn) while at Kronmat and Torghallen the Families segment moved in line with total visits.

Grosshallen Nordstaden in Uppsala is the peer playbook store: same cluster (Grosshallen / Suburban family) and a similar catchment but it captures about 97 percent of its potential with like-for-like growth of about +3.5 percent. Compared with Västerhamn it has about 7 points higher private-label share (about 21 versus 14 percent) availability of about 98 percent and a markdown rate about 40 percent lower.

The recommended action for Grosshallen Västerhamn is a 12-week test of the Nordstaden playbook: restore Dairy and Bread availability to at least 96 percent through revised order parameters and a second daily bread delivery and relist the private-label range to lift its share above 20 percent and replace blanket markdowns with targeted loyalty offers for the Families segment. Closing half the gap to the cluster median is worth roughly SEK 40 million of annual sales.

Kronmat Fresh & Produce is the growth-with-margin-erosion case: category sales grew about 12 percent over the rolling 12 months but its gross margin fell about 2 points because of promotional depth. The Sommarpris 2026 campaign (Kronmat Fresh & Produce price cut of 30 percent from 2026-06-15 to 2026-08-09 retailer funded) had the strongest uplift of all 60 campaigns (about 52 percent) and the worst margin dilution (about 7.5 points) and is the reference example of strong sales with weak margin.
Promotion verdicts in V_PROMO_EFFECTIVENESS: Strong sales weak margin means uplift of at least 25 percent with margin dilution of at least 4 points. Fourteen of the 60 campaigns fall in that band.

Catchment data comes from the market-data provider once a year. Catchment potential is the annual net sales a store of that format should achieve in its catchment (grocery spend within the catchment times a fair share that falls with the number of competitors). The potential index is rolling-12-month sales divided by potential: below 0.75 is Underperforming and 0.75 to 0.90 is Below potential.

A peer cluster is the banner combined with the catchment type (Urban core Suburban family Small town Commuter belt Rural hub). Stores are compared with the median of their own cluster in V_PEER_COMPARISON not with the whole chain.

Grosshallen sells an imported non-food range (apparel and footwear home and kitchen electronics toys sports and cosmetics) of 250 SKUs listed in NONFOOD_ASSORTMENT. The range is bought through the import-purchasing platform Grosshallen brought into the group which runs on Teradata and is attached to this domain as the federated connection Ali-TD (database wisdomai tables RTL_DIM_SUPPLIER RTL_DIM_PRODUCT RTL_FACT_PURCHASE_ORDER_LINE RTL_VW_PURCHASE_ORDER). PRODUCT_KEY and SUPPLIER_KEY are the same keys in both systems.

To explain non-food stockouts with inbound supply: take lost sales by SUPPLIER_KEY from V_NONFOOD_AVAILABILITY_BY_SUPPLIER in Snowflake and the supplier name country lead time and purchase-order lateness (days_late and po_status) from the Teradata tables and combine the two results on SUPPLIER_KEY. Query each system separately in its own SQL dialect (Teradata uses TOP n instead of LIMIT) and join the results in the analysis step.

Three import suppliers run late: Sterling Trading (supplier key 39 Germany) Frontier Trading (key 26 Vietnam) and Lakeshore Industries (key 52 Mexico) have the highest average days late and the most short-received purchase-order lines in the purchasing platform. Their SKUs account for about 68 percent of Grosshallen non-food lost sales (about SEK 22 million of SEK 32 million over the rolling 12 months) from about 29 percent of non-food sales. At Grosshallen Västerhamn their availability is about 83 percent.

Food price deflation: Swedish food prices fell about 2 percent year on year in 2026 and the food VAT rate was cut from 12 to 6 percent on 2026-04-01 which lifted volumes. Net sales are reported excluding VAT so growth in 2026 is volume driven while shelf prices fell.

Nordmark reports on calendar quarters (QUARTER_LABEL such as 2026-Q3 = July to September 2026). Months are keyed by MONTH_START_DATE and weeks by WEEK_START_DATE (the Monday of the ISO week). The last 13 complete weeks start 2026-06-29 through 2026-09-21.

Waste rate is waste cost divided by net sales and markdown rate is markdown value divided by net sales. Both are managed KPIs for fresh categories (Fresh & Produce Dairy Bread & Bakery Meat & Poultry Fish & Seafood Deli & Charcuterie Ready Meals Flowers & Garden).

Nordmark sales regions are Stockholm Vast (west incl. Göteborg) Syd (south incl. Malmö and Helsingborg) Ost (east incl. Linköping) Mitt (incl. Uppsala Västerås Örebro) and Norr (north incl. Umeå and Luleå).

The Kampanjrapport is the campaign planners' weekly report: campaign performance and forecast accuracy by chain (kedja) and campaign week (vecka) with one row per campaign week and article. The row key is Nyckel = week label plus article id. It used to be a MicroStrategy report and now reads V_KAMPANJRAPPORT. Use the kampanjrapport skill or /kampanjrapport <kedja> <vecka> so the grid comes out the same every time.

Forecast error percent = (forecast minus actual sold) divided by actual sold and positive means over-forecast. Totals are ratios of sums never averages of row percentages. Såld prognos is the group CatBoost demand model and Köpt prognos (kedjans prognos) is the chain's own purchase plan. Planerad kvantitet is the purchase forecast rounded up to whole cases.

A campaign week is the ISO week of the first delivery day (leverans_fran) and is keyed as kalender_vecka_id YYYYWW with the label YYYY-Www. Completed campaign weeks run from 2024-W42 to 2026-W39. Weeks 2026-W41 to 2026-W44 are planned campaigns with forecasts but no actual sales yet and appear in V_KAMPANJ_KOMMANDE.

Tactic type (taktiktyp) is the promotion mechanic used to group campaigns: Prisnedsättning (PN) Multiköp 3 för 2 (MK) Medlemspris (MP) Halva priset (HP) and Kupong (KU). A campaign has exactly one tactic type.

In Kronmat campaign week 2026-W36 (the Höstskörd theme with four campaigns and 28 article rows) the chain purchase forecast was 18 percent above actual sold while the CatBoost forecast was 6 percent above. The campaigns were Höstskörd Veckans pris Höstskörd 3 för 2 Höstskörd Medlemspris and Höstskörd Halva priset.

Forecast error is highest on Multiköp 3 för 2 campaigns: over the last 13 completed campaign weeks the chain purchase forecast over-forecast perishable multibuy articles by about 31 percent while every other tactic type stayed within 9 percent. Perishables carry about 87 percent of the absolute forecast error.

Grosshallen Västerhamn has the worst campaign forecast deviation of all Grosshallen stores over the rolling 12 months (about 37 percent over-forecast) and about 53 percent in the weeks after the Billigmat opening on 2026-03-12 because the chain plan still allocated pre-opening volumes to the store. Grosshallen Nordstaden sits in the best quartile.

Over-forecasting cost about SEK 10.8 million of margin in Q3 2026 on the illustrative cost data: about 79 percent is waste (svinn) on perishables and the rest clearance markdowns. Kronmat Multiköp 3 för 2 campaigns are the largest single share at about 32 percent. Finance has not been migrated so every cost figure carries the label ILLUSTRATIV - finanssystem ej migrerat from the KALLA column and must be presented as indicative.

Four upcoming perishable campaigns are flagged because the chain purchase forecast exceeds the CatBoost forecast by more than 15 percent: Mejerivecka 3 för 2 (Kronmat 2026-W41) Äpplen & Päron (Torghallen 2026-W42) Brödfest 3 för 2 (Grosshallen 2026-W43) and Köttvecka 3 för 2 (Kronmat 2026-W44). No dry-grocery campaign exceeds the threshold.

The order adjustment draft for Äpplen & Päron (Torghallen week 2026-W42 delivery from 2026-10-12 planner Viktor Holmgren 20 fruit articles) cuts the purchase by about 45 thousand units or 17 percent in whole pallet layers and protects about SEK 640 thousand of margin on the illustrative cost data. A draft is never an order: the responsible planner (ansvarig planerare) approves it and nothing is sent to the order system by Wisdom.

Order adjustments are expressed in cases (kolli = units per case) rounded down to whole pallet layers (lav = cases per layer); pall is cases per pallet. The rule for a proposed cut is FORESLAGEN_MINSKNING_KOLLI in V_KAMPANJ_KOMMANDE and a cut never goes below the CatBoost forecast.

Swedish terms in the campaign data: Kedja = chain or banner Vecka = week Kampanj = campaign Artikel = article or SKU Butik = store Såld prognos = sold forecast Köpt prognos or Kedjans prognos = the chain's purchase forecast Nyckel = key Kolli Pall Lav = case pallet layer Kvitto = receipt Färskvara = perishable Svinn = waste EMV or egna märkesvaror = private label. Users may ask in Swedish or English.

To explain a forecast variance follow the prognosavvikelse skill: tactic type then perishability then article then store then week and check only three causes (competitor events within 2 km in the prior 90 days from HAR_KONKURRENTHANDELSE_90D Dairy and Bread availability and loyalty segment visits). Say coincides with not caused by.

Store-level campaign forecast deviation lives in V_KAMPANJ_BUTIK_AVVIKELSE (campaign x store x week with the store's peer cluster and a competitor-event flag). The chain purchase forecast is allocated to stores by store size so a store deviation measures how far the allocated plan missed that store's actual campaign sales.

Campaign planning owners: the Head of Campaign Planning (Sofia Lindahl) owns the Kampanjrapport and the forecast definitions and Demand Planning Analytics (Karl Öberg) stewards the campaign mart. Each campaign has a responsible planner in KAMPANJ.ANSVARIG_PLANERARE who approves order adjustments.
